verifyDialog.title: API Verification

agent.completed: An SVG file was generated. Judge the drawing yourself.
agent.hint: Let the model check and improve its drawing. This may increase usage.
agent.label: Agent test mode
agent.noArtifact: The model did not create pelican.svg with complete SVG markup. Its final reply is not used as the artifact.

context.description: Uses the declared model context as the test cap, or up to 1M tokens when unknown. Each batch has about an 8M-token cumulative input budget and can resume after pausing.
context.emptyResponse: The response ended normally without answer text; input acceptance remains unconfirmed.
context.hint: Tests the input context the model can accept. Results depend on the API and request configuration and do not establish the full context window.
context.historyError: History is unavailable. The current result is still shown.
context.incompleteResponse: No conclusive response was received. Finish reason: {{reason}}.
context.interrupted: The request was interrupted; its charge status is unknown. It was not retried. Start a new test only if you accept the possible additional usage.
context.lower: Largest accepted input: {{tokens}} local text tokens
context.matched: Model encoding matched; full-request token count may differ.
context.outputLimited: Input accepted; output was truncated at a length limit. This does not invalidate input acceptance.
context.progress: Requests: {{requests}} · Approx. cumulative input budget used: {{tokens}} tokens (including failed requests)

reasons.bracketed: Found an approximate input boundary for this connection.
reasons.budget: This batch reached its request or cumulative input budget. Continue from here to allow more usage.
reasons.inconclusive: The response did not confirm a capacity limit. Retry or open execution details to see the cause.
reasons.test-limit: This input length was accepted. The actual capacity may be larger.
reasons.timeout: The request timed out before input acceptance could be confirmed. A timeout does not prove the input exceeds model capacity. Try again later; retrying sends long text again and may use credits.

context.reportedUsage: Reported usage: input {{input}} + output {{output}} = total {{total}} tokens
context.startHint: Sends long text and uses API credits. Pauses at its usage budget.
context.title: Model context test
context.upper: Capacity rejection at: {{tokens}} local text tokens

pelican.description: Asks the model to draw a pelican riding a bicycle as SVG for a side-by-side look. Judgement stays manual.
pelican.historyOnly: Only the run summary was saved. Run again to view the drawing and execution details.
pelican.noSvg: The model returned no SVG markup.
pelican.previewFailed: The SVG could not be displayed. It may contain invalid XML, such as duplicate attributes. Expand the raw answer or workspace files to inspect it.
pelican.title: Drawing test
pelican.unsafe: The answer contained script or external references, so it was not rendered.

prompts.sharedHint: Saved prompts are shared by every verification entry point.

tools.stopped: Stopped before finishing; nothing was recorded.
